$comment: Curated catalog. This file is the source of truth for structure; TMDb is
only ever allowed to fill in poster_url, synopsis, runtime_min and tmdb_id
via backend/scripts/enrich_tmdb.py. Phases, sagas, tiers and above all the
dependency edges are editorial judgements no API can supply.
ARRAY ORDER IS THE CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER. chrono_order is assigned from array
position and release_order is derived from release_date, so neither is
hand-written and neither can drift. Re-ordering the in-universe timeline is
a cut-and-paste in this file.
The loader asserts that this array order is itself a valid topological sort
of the edges below -- that single check catches most authoring mistakes.
Edges are kept transitively reduced: if A requires B and B requires C, the
A->C edge is omitted. Redundant edges clutter the graph visualisation, and
the loader warns about them.
Tier A: MCU live-action films, Disney+ series and specials. Tier B --
Sony, Fox, Netflix, ABC and the animated spin-offs -- interleaves into the
same array wherever it falls on the merged in-universe timeline, with
`saga`/`universe` set to its own franchise rather than the MCU's. `tier`
grades importance within that franchise same as it does for Tier A, so
it is no longer a reliable 'is this the MCU' signal on its own -- for
that, see `MCU_UNIVERSES` in app.core.enums, which is what
`include_adjacent=False` actually filters on.

movies.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
movies.synopsis: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: Agent Carter
movies.synopsis: Agent Peggy Carter is relegated to a desk job and frustrated at her male boss and comrades' sexist dismissal of her place in the SSR. Ordered to work late one night, Carter gets an alert that the villain Zodiac has been spotted and decides to take care of it herself.

movies.title: Marvel's Agent Carter: Season 1
movies.synopsis: Years before Agent Phil Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. team swore to protect those who cannot protect themselves from threats they cannot conceive, there was Agent Peggy Carter, who pledged the same oath but lived in a different time, when women weren't recognized as being as smart or as tough as their male counterparts. But no one should ever underestimate Peggy.

movies.title: Marvel's Agent Carter: Season 2
movies.synopsis: Dedicated to the fight against new Atomic Age threats in the wake of World War II, Peggy must now journey from New York City to Los Angeles and she's about to find out that the bright lights of the post-war Hollywood mask a more sinister threat to everyone she is sworn to protect.

movies.title: X-Men: First Class
movies.synopsis: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.

movies.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
movies.synopsis: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.

movies.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
movies.synopsis: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

movies.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
movies.synopsis: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

movies.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
movies.synopsis: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.

movies.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
movies.synopsis: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens that want to use Grey's new abilities to rule the galaxy.

movies.title: Captain Marvel
movies.synopsis: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

movies.title: X-Men '97
movies.synopsis: The X-Men, a band of mutants who use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them, are challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

movies.title: X-Men
movies.synopsis: Two mutants, Rogue and Wolverine, come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team, the X-Men, must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.

movies.title: Spider-Man
movies.synopsis: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

movies.title: X2: X-Men United
movies.synopsis: Professor Charles Xavier and his team of genetically gifted superheroes face a rising tide of anti-mutant sentiment led by Col. William Stryker. Storm, Wolverine and Jean Grey must join Magneto and Mystique to unhinge Stryker's scheme to exterminate all mutants.

movies.title: Spider-Man 2
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...

movies.title: Fantastic Four
movies.synopsis: During a space voyage, four scientists are altered by cosmic rays: Reed Richards gains the ability to stretch his body; Sue Storm can become invisible; Johnny Storm controls fire; and Ben Grimm is turned into a super-strong … thing. Together, these "Fantastic Four" must now thwart the evil plans of Dr. Doom and save the world from certain destruction.

movies.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
movies.synopsis: When a cure is found to treat mutations, lines are drawn amongst the X-Men led by Professor Charles Xavier, and Magneto's Brotherhood of Mutants.

movies.title: Spider-Man 3

prerequisites.note: Continues Harry's revenge arc and introduces Sandman directly

movies.synopsis: The seemingly invincible Spider-Man goes up against an all-new crop of villains—including the shape-shifting Sandman. While Spider-Man’s superpowers are altered by an alien organism, his alter ego, Peter Parker, deals with nemesis Eddie Brock and also gets caught up in a love triangle.

movies.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

prerequisites.note: Picks up Reed and Sue's wedding and the team dynamic directly

movies.synopsis: The Fantastic Four return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable 'Silver Surfer', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.synopsis: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

movies.title: Iron Man 2

prerequisites.note: Picks up directly from Tony's public reveal

movies.synopsis: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

movies.title: The Incredible Hulk
movies.synopsis: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the Hulk. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: The Consultant

prerequisites.note: Turns on Emil Blonsky's imprisonment after the Hulk's rampage

movies.synopsis: Agent Coulson informs Agent Sitwell that the World Security Council wishes Emil Blonsky to be released from prison to join the Avengers Initiative. As Nick Fury doesn't want to release Blonsky, the two agents decide to send a patsy to sabotage the meeting...

movies.title: Thor
movies.synopsis: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer

prerequisites.note: Coulson's aside about the search for Mjolnir references it directly

movies.synopsis: Agent Coulson stops at a convenience store and deals with a coincidental robbery during his visit.

movies.title: The Avengers

prerequisites.note: Sets up Black Widow, Fury and the Avengers Initiative
Establishes Loki's grievance and the Tesseract
Steve Rogers, and where the Tesseract came from
Introduces Banner on the run, though he is recast here

movies.synopsis: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: Item 47

prerequisites.note: A couple scavenges alien tech left over from the Battle of New York

movies.synopsis: Benny and Claire, a down-on-their-luck couple, find a discarded Chitauri weapon referred to as 'Item 47'.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
movies.synopsis: A teenage Peter Parker grapples with both high school and amazing super-human crises as his alter-ego Spider-Man.

movies.title: Iron Man 3

prerequisites.note: The whole film is about Tony's panic attacks after New York

movies.synopsis: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

movies.title: The Wolverine

prerequisites.note: Logan is grieving Jean's death from X3 throughout

movies.synopsis: Wolverine faces his ultimate nemesis - and tests of his physical, emotional, and mortal limits - in a life-changing voyage to modern-day Japan.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 1 (Episodes 1–7)

prerequisites.note: Coulson's revival and the team's premise are fallout from the Battle of New York

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Thor: The Dark World

prerequisites.note: Opens with Loki imprisoned for the invasion

movies.synopsis: Thor fights to restore order across the cosmos… but an ancient race led by the vengeful Malekith returns to plunge the universe back into darkness. Faced with an enemy that even Odin and Asgard cannot withstand, Thor must embark on his most perilous and personal journey yet, one that will reunite him with Jane Foster and force him to sacrifice everything to save us all.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 1 (Episodes 8–16)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same season

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: All Hail the King

prerequisites.note: Trevor Slattery's fake-Mandarin con is the entire premise

movies.synopsis: A documentary filmmaker interviews the now-famous Trevor Slattery from behind bars.

movies.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier

prerequisites.note: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s expansion after New York is the premise

movies.synopsis: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-widening conspiracy while fighting off professional assassins sent to silence him at every turn. When the full scope of the villainous plot is revealed, Captain America and the Black Widow enlist the help of a new ally, the Falcon. However, they soon find themselves up against an unexpected and formidable enemy—the Winter Soldier.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 1 (Episodes 17–21)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same season
Hydra's reveal inside S.H.I.E.L.D. is this run's climax

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of Peter and Gwen's story

movies.synopsis: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as Spider-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Peter has not forgotten about the promise he made to Gwen’s father to protect her by staying away, but that is a promise he cannot keep. Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old friend, Harry Osborn, returns, and Peter uncovers new clues about his past.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy

prerequisites.note: Introduces the Collector and the Infinity Stones as objects

movies.synopsis: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation, months later

movies.synopsis: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 2 (Episodes 1–10)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same series

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Marvel's Daredevil: Season 1

movies.synopsis: Blinded as a young boy, Matt Murdock fights injustice by day as a lawyer and by night as the superhero Daredevil in Hell's Kitchen, New York City.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 2 (Episodes 11–19)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same season

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron

prerequisites.note: The Avengers are hunting HYDRA because S.H.I.E.L.D. fell
Tony's fear of failing the world drives Ultron

movies.synopsis: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 2 (Episodes 20–22)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same season

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Ant-Man

prerequisites.note: The new Avengers compound, and Falcon's cameo

movies.synopsis: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.

movies.title: Fantastic Four
movies.synopsis: Four young outsiders teleport to a dangerous universe, which alters their physical form in shocking ways. Their lives irrevocably upended, the team must learn to harness their daunting new abilities and work together to save Earth from a former friend turned enemy.

movies.title: Marvel's Jessica Jones: Season 1

prerequisites.note: Same Hell's Kitchen corner of the MCU

movies.synopsis: Haunted by a traumatic past, Jessica Jones uses her gifts as a private eye to find her tormentor before he can harm anyone else in Hell's Kitchen.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 3 (Episodes 1–10)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same series

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Deadpool
movies.synopsis: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

movies.title: Marvel's Daredevil: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation

movies.synopsis: Dark forces are tearing Hell's Kitchen apart once again, but this time Daredevil may have to choose between the city and his friends.

movies.title: Marvel's Luke Cage: Season 1

prerequisites.note: Luke Cage is introduced there

movies.synopsis: As the bulletproof defender of Harlem, Luke Cage battles corrupt politicians, ruthless gangsters and demons from his own past.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 3 (Episodes 11–19)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same season

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Captain America: Civil War

prerequisites.note: Sokovia is the reason the Accords exist
Scott Lang turns up on Cap's side out of nowhere otherwise

movies.synopsis: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

movies.title: Black Widow

prerequisites.note: Natasha is a fugitive from the Accords throughout

movies.synopsis: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.

movies.title: Black Panther

prerequisites.note: T'Challa takes the throne because of what happens there

movies.synopsis: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 3 (Episodes 20–22)

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same season
The finale turns on the Sokovia Accords' fallout

movies.synopsis: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming

prerequisites.note: Opens on Peter's recruitment and the airport fight

movies.synopsis: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

movies.title: Marvel's Iron Fist: Season 1
movies.synopsis: Fifteen years after being presumed dead in a plane crash, Danny Rand mysteriously returns to New York City determined to reclaim his birthright and family company. However, when a long-destined enemy rises in New York, this living weapon is forced to choose between his family’s legacy and his duties as the Iron Fist.

movies.title: Doctor Strange
movies.synopsis: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 4

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same series

movies.synopsis: Vengeance runs rampant this season as Coulson is a mere agent again, and Daisy has gone rogue after being under Hive's control. How will S.H.I.E.L.D. deal with the arrival of The Ghost Rider?

movies.title: Marvel's Inhumans: Season 1

prerequisites.note: Shares the Inhuman-outbreak premise introduced there

movies.synopsis: The Royal Family of Inhumans is thrust from their secret home of Attilan and must adjust to a strange new world: Hawaii.

movies.title: Marvel's The Defenders: Season 1

prerequisites.note: Unites all four Netflix heroes' solo runs
Unites all four Netflix heroes' solo runs
Unites all four Netflix heroes' solo runs
Unites all four Netflix heroes' solo runs

movies.synopsis: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist join forces to take on common enemies as a sinister conspiracy threatens New York City.

movies.title: Marvel's The Punisher: Season 1

prerequisites.note: Frank Castle is introduced there

movies.synopsis: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

movies.title: Thor: Ragnarok

prerequisites.note: Resolves who has actually been ruling Asgard
Thor left to chase the vision this film pays off
The Sanctum Sanctorum sequence assumes you know Strange

movies.synopsis: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

movies.title: Marvel's Jessica Jones: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation

movies.synopsis: Drowning in anger, Jessica Jones is forced to reckon with her past, her powers and her newfound fame as she dishes out her own messy form of justice. Finally ready to face her past, Jessica hunts down the source of her powers and uncovers a link to a shadowy killer who's terrorizing the city.

movies.title: Deadpool 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation

movies.synopsis: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool battles the evil and powerful Cable and other bad guys to save a boy's life.

movies.title: Marvel's Luke Cage: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation
Picks up after the team-up

movies.synopsis: As his fame and responsibility soar, Luke Cage finds his life upended by a mysterious newcomer with powers of his own -- and a plan to take over Harlem.

movies.title: Marvel's Iron Fist: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation
Picks up after the team-up

movies.synopsis: As a gang war brews in New York's Chinatown, Danny and Colleen strive to protect the innocent while battling fearsome enemies both old and new.

movies.title: Marvel's Daredevil: Season 3

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation
The Midland Circle collapse is the point of departure

movies.synopsis: Missing for months, Matt Murdock reemerges a broken man, putting into question his future as both vigilante Daredevil and lawyer Matthew Murdock. But when his archenemy Wilson Fisk is released from prison, Matt must choose between hiding from the world, or embracing his destiny as a hero.

movies.title: Marvel's Runaways: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation

movies.synopsis: The Runaways have left their homes (and evil parents) behind and now have to learn to live on their own. As they scavenge for food, search for shelter, and take care of one another, our kids begin to realize that, for better or worse, they’re stuck with each other. And it’s up to them to take down PRIDE once and for all. But someone sent a mysterious message to Jonah… Is there a mole in the Runaways? Meanwhile PRIDE is focused on finding their children, and Jonah has his own dangerous plan in mind.

movies.title: Marvel's The Punisher: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation

movies.synopsis: Frank strives to protect a teenager caught in a sinister conspiracy while doing whatever it takes -- and then some -- to end Russo once and for all.

movies.title: Marvel's Cloak & Dagger: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation

movies.synopsis: Season two turns the heat up on our young heroes as Tyrone and Tandy try to find their place as more active heroes in this world. As they learn and grow emotionally, so will their skills. With enhanced powers and a decision to make about the type of heroes they want to be, they make the choice to run into the danger, head first. They tackle a heartless vigilante and uncover an evil that’s been preying on the young women of the city, as the show takes on more serious topics like gang violence and human trafficking.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.synopsis: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spider-Verse to be inadvertently transported to his dimension.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 5

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same series

movies.synopsis: Agent Coulson and the team escaped LMD Aida’s Framework and awakened in the real world. Little did they know that Aida was now fully human – and with multiple Inhuman abilities – with the dangerous notion that, with Fitz by her side, she could change the world. After defeating her with the aid of Ghost Rider, the team went out for a celebration but were interrupted by a mysterious man who rendered them frozen. The next thing we see is Coulson onboard a ship … in space. Coulson will discover that some, but not all, of his S.H.I.E.L.D. colleagues were taken with him and placed onboard the ship. As they come in contact with some of the vessel’s inhabitants, it becomes abundantly clear that something has gone terribly awry, and the team will need to figure out their role and delve deeper into this nightmarish mystery to try to right what has gone incredibly wrong.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp

prerequisites.note: Continues Hank and Janet's story directly
Scott is under house arrest for the airport fight

movies.synopsis: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War

prerequisites.note: Opens moments after Ragnarok's final scene
Gamora and Nebula's history with Thanos is the emotional core
The third act is the battle of Wakanda
The Time Stone and Strange's judgement drive the plot
Peter's arc lands only if you have met him

movies.synopsis: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 6

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same series

movies.synopsis: Last season, the team leaped forward in time to a dystopian future they soon realized must be prevented. While facing multiple timelines and new enemies from faraway planets, they found family, friends, teammates and the courage to pull off their biggest challenge yet. Their next challenge? Coming to grips with the knowledge that bending the laws of space and time may have saved the planet, but it couldn’t save Fitz or Coulson.

movies.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Season 7

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same series

movies.synopsis: Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. are thrust backward in time and stranded in 1931 New York City. With the all-new Zephyr set to time-jump at any moment, the team must hurry to find out exactly what happened. If they fail, it would mean disaster for the past, present and future of the world.

movies.title: Marvel's Runaways: Season 3

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation

movies.synopsis: The Runaways frantically search for their captured friends Chase, Gert and Karolina. The kids go head to head with an unstoppable enemy who has targeted Leslie - or more accurately, the child she's carrying. Nico draws them all into a dark realm where its ruler Morgan le Fay, is much more nefarious than anyone the kids have yet to face.

movies.title: Marvel's Helstrom: Season 1
movies.synopsis: The adult children of a legendary serial killer track down the worst of humanity, each with their own mysterious ties to their father's dark legacy.

movies.title: The New Mutants
movies.synopsis: Five young mutants, just discovering their abilities while held in a secret facility against their will, fight to escape their past sins and save themselves.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame

prerequisites.note: Picks up in the immediate aftermath of the snap
Carol arrives in the first act with no introduction
The Quantum Realm cliffhanger is the entire plan

movies.synopsis: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

movies.title: Loki

prerequisites.note: Begins at the exact moment this Loki escapes with the Tesseract

movies.synopsis: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

movies.title: What If...?

prerequisites.note: Every episode is a variation on something you are assumed to know
Establishes the branching timelines these stories live in

movies.synopsis: Taking inspiration from the comic books of the same name, each episode of this animated anthology series questions, revisits and twists classic Marvel Cinematic moments.

movies.title: WandaVision

prerequisites.note: Wanda's grief for Vision is the premise

movies.synopsis: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

movies.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

prerequisites.note: Sam inherits the shield in the final scene

movies.synopsis: Following the events of “Avengers: Endgame”, the Falcon, Sam Wilson and the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes team up in a global adventure that tests their abilities, and their patience.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

prerequisites.note: Mostly standalone; the Blip and the epilogue cameos assume it

movies.synopsis: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.

movies.title: Eternals

prerequisites.note: The return of half the population is the film's inciting event

movies.synopsis: The Eternals are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home

prerequisites.note: Peter is grieving Tony and the world is coping with the Blip

movies.synopsis: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home

prerequisites.note: Opens on the exact frame that film ended on

movies.synopsis: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

prerequisites.note: Strange has already torn the multiverse open
Wanda's turn makes no sense without her arc there
The incursion rules and one major cameo are set up here

movies.synopsis: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.

movies.title: Morbius

prerequisites.note: The mid-credits scene pulls Vulture in from the multiverse-crossing there

movies.synopsis: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder, and determined to save others suffering his same fate, Dr. Michael Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. What at first appears to be a radical success soon reveals itself to be a remedy potentially worse than the disease.

movies.title: Hawkeye

prerequisites.note: Clint is processing Natasha's death and his Ronin years
Yelena's motive comes entirely from that post-credits scene

movies.synopsis: Former Avenger Clint Barton has a seemingly simple mission: get back to his family for Christmas. Possible? Maybe with the help of Kate Bishop, a 22-year-old archer with dreams of becoming a superhero. The two are forced to work together when a presence from Barton’s past threatens to derail far more than the festive spirit.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

prerequisites.note: The TVA and its rules about sacred timelines are the plot's engine
The joke density assumes the Infinity Saga

movies.synopsis: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

movies.title: Moon Knight
movies.synopsis: When Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift-shop employee, becomes plagued with blackouts and memories of another life, he discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Steven/Marc’s enemies converge upon them, they must navigate their complex identities while thrust into a deadly mystery among the powerful gods of Egypt.

movies.title: Echo

prerequisites.note: Maya's vendetta against Fisk begins there

movies.synopsis: Pursued by Wilson Fisk's criminal empire, Maya's journey brings her home and she must confront her own family and legacy.

movies.title: Ms. Marvel

prerequisites.note: Kamala is a fan of Avengers you need to have met
Carol is Kamala's idol and the finale's payoff

movies.synopsis: A great student, avid gamer, and voracious fan-fic scribe, Kamala Khan has a special affinity for superheroes, particularly Captain Marvel. However, she struggles to fit in at home and at school — that is, until she gets superpowers like the heroes she’s always looked up to. Life is easier with superpowers, right?

movies.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law

prerequisites.note: Bruce's Smart Hulk state and the five-year gap are assumed
Wong and Abomination's fight-club arrangement starts there

movies.synopsis: Jennifer Walters navigates the complicated life of a single, 30-something attorney who also happens to be a green 6-foot-7-inch superpowered hulk.

movies.title: Thor: Love and Thunder

prerequisites.note: Thor leaves with the Guardians at the end of it

movies.synopsis: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, Thor Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

movies.title: I Am Groot: Seasons 1 & 2

prerequisites.note: Baby Groot's baby-hood begins there

movies.synopsis: There's no guarding the galaxy from this mischievous toddler! Get ready as Baby Groot takes center stage in his very own collection of shorts, exploring his glory days growing up and getting into trouble among the stars.

movies.title: Werewolf by Night
movies.synopsis: On a dark and somber night, a secret cabal of monster hunters emerge from the shadows and gather at the foreboding Bloodstone Temple following the death of their leader. In a strange and macabre memorial to the leader’s life, the attendees are thrust into a mysterious and deadly competition for a powerful relic—a hunt that will ultimately bring them face to face with a dangerous monster.

movies.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

prerequisites.note: The whole film is about the succession it set up
Wakanda's place in the world after the Blip

movies.synopsis: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.

movies.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

prerequisites.note: Assumes Mantis and Peter's family history
The team has just parted ways with Thor

movies.synopsis: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania

prerequisites.note: Janet's thirty years in the Quantum Realm are the whole plot
Scott is a public hero because of the time heist
You have already met a version of Kang there

movies.synopsis: Super-Hero partners Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne, along with with Hope's parents Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym, and Scott's daughter Cassie Lang, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought possible.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3

prerequisites.note: Knowhere is now the team's home, established there

movies.synopsis: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.

movies.title: Secret Invasion

prerequisites.note: Fury's promise to the Skrulls is the betrayal at its heart
Rhodey and the geopolitical state of play

movies.synopsis: Nick Fury and Talos discover a faction of shapeshifting Skrulls who have been infiltrating Earth for years.

movies.title: The Marvels

prerequisites.note: Kamala's powers and the bangle are introduced there
Monica gains her powers in that finale
Explains where Fury has been and the Skrull refugee crisis

movies.synopsis: When her duties send her to an anomalous wormhole linked to a Kree revolutionary, Carol's powers become entangled with that of Jersey City super-fan Kamala Khan, aka Ms. Marvel, and Carol's estranged niece, now S.A.B.E.R. astronaut Captain Monica Rambeau. Together, this unlikely trio must team up and learn to work in concert to save the universe.

movies.title: Loki: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Resumes seconds after the first season's finale
Fills in who Kang is beyond He Who Remains

movies.synopsis: In the aftermath of Season 1, Loki finds himself in a battle for the soul of the Time Variance Authority. Along with Mobius, Hunter B-15 and a team of new and returning characters, Loki navigates an ever-expanding and increasingly dangerous multiverse in search of Sylvie, Judge Renslayer, Miss Minutes and the truth of what it means to possess free will and glorious purpose.

movies.title: What If...?: Season 2

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same anthology

movies.synopsis: Season two continues the journey as The Watcher guides viewers through the vast multiverse, introducing brand new and familiar faces throughout the MCU.

movies.title: What If...?: Season 3

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation of the same anthology

movies.synopsis: Season 3 follows classic characters as they make unexpected choices that will mutate their worlds into spectacular alternate versions of the MCU.

movies.title: Ironheart

prerequisites.note: Riri builds her first suit there

movies.synopsis: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

movies.title: Agatha All Along

prerequisites.note: Opens with Agatha still under Wanda's hex

movies.synopsis: Agatha Harkness gathers a coven of witches and sets off down, down, down The Witches' Road.

movies.title: Daredevil: Born Again

prerequisites.note: Follows directly from Fisk's fate at the end of it
Where this version of Matt Murdock is reintroduced

movies.synopsis: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

movies.title: Captain America: Brave New World

prerequisites.note: Sam has only just accepted the shield
Pays off Thaddeus Ross and the Leader after seventeen years
The Celestial in the ocean is the resource everyone is fighting over

movies.synopsis: After meeting with newly elected U.S. President Thaddeus Ross, Sam finds himself in the middle of an international incident. He must discover the reason behind a nefarious global plot before the true mastermind has the entire world seeing red.

movies.title: Thunderbolts*

prerequisites.note: Yelena is working for Valentina by the end of it
John Walker and Valentina both come from there
Ghost's whereabouts since the Quantum Realm
Valentina's manoeuvring against Ross

movies.synopsis: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

movies.title: Wonder Man

prerequisites.note: Shares the industry-satire register and Los Angeles setting

movies.synopsis: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

movies.title: Logan

prerequisites.note: Picks up Logan's arc directly, decades later

movies.synopsis: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day

prerequisites.note: Picks up with Peter erased from everyone's memory, exactly where that film left him

movies.synopsis: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Avengers: Doomsday

prerequisites.note: The New Avengers assembled there are the film's core team
Thaddeus Ross' Red Hulk carries forward
The multiverse incursions this film reckons with build on Wade and Logan crossing over
Brings Marvel's First Family into the main timeline

movies.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

movies.title: Avengers: Secret Wars

prerequisites.note: Direct continuation -- the Multiverse Saga's finale

movies.synopsis: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga.
